description: This PHP file defines the TimezoneName class, a validation rule to check if a given input is a valid timezone name. The class extends AbstractRule and provides a validate method that uses PHP's DateTimeZone class to verify timezone validity.

classes.name: TimezoneName
classes.description: A validation rule class to verify that a given string is a valid timezone name using PHP's DateTimeZone.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Checks if the input is a string and a valid timezone name.

methods.name: isValidTimezone
methods.description: Attempts to create a DateTimeZone with the given name; returns true if successful, false otherwise.

methods.description: Public method to validate the input as a timezone name.
